name.description: Original noun phrase. Never borrowed from prior decks.

standard.description: The positive quality this defect violates. Small fixed set per category.

definition.description: A falsifiable presence test: 'Present when ...' — answerable yes/no against a real product. If an auditor cannot answer yes/no, the definition is defective.

detectable_from.description: Honest inputs. An audit run refuses findings its input cannot support and reports them as not-assessed.

example.description: A documented real instance. Entries without a real instance or a standards hook do not ship.
